ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   D. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   C. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.
   B. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fatimid Dynasty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Africa 4.4 Influence of Islam in Africa 4.5 Muslim Scholars Page 12 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Influence of Islam in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
